title: Reduce live matrix stock and activate all six stages inside the fast multiplier
body:
This construction reduces the live matrix stock of the six-stage general integer multiplier and puts all six stages inside a genuine numerical Fourier operation at a substantially smaller input length. It preserves the complete proposed **κ = 0.00387992803556** for arbitrary signed binary operands. Both the old lower bound and the new sufficient bound count a nested call whose result reaches the integer product. [Resource derivations](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/RESOURCES.md) · [Complete composition](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/INTEGRATION.md) · [Execution and kernel receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/EVIDENCE.json)

| Quantity | Previous complete construction | This construction |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| True high matrices per invertible low and owner | 3^(N²(w−1)) | 3^(N²(u−1)), using balanced components of total width w and largest width u |
| Necessary old / sufficient new log₂ p for the connected native path | Greater than 470632530120481927710843371 | 3840000000000000 suffices for all later lengths |
| Minimum records in the two-trit, rank-two physical fixture | 25,509,168 | 314,928 |
| Extra backing at the same 25,509,168 four-byte records | 516,560,652 bytes | 7,637,004 bytes |
| Total backing for that matched-payload route | 618,597,324 bytes | 109,673,676 bytes |
| Reads, writes and absolute seek distance for that route | 17,052,878,808 byte positions | 43,582,413,528 byte positions |

Here p = 6 ceil(log₂ n) for input length n. The ratio of the compared logarithmic thresholds exceeds **122,560,554,718**. A sufficient input length is **2^ceil(2^3840000000000000 / 6) bits**. The low matrix space alone still has more than 3^(N²)/2 configurations for N = 2^240000000000000. The numerical rank is M = 2^3300000000. Fixed setup retains the N^20000 envelope. The recurring constant has the same upper-bound form with unresolved absolute factors. The complete machine still uses linear storage. Its additional backing above signed I/O and persistent tensor banks falls from Ω(n) at a full old CRT shuttle to O_F(n/√log n) plus fixed installation and the separately bounded private compiler. There is no practical crossover measurement. [Outer thresholds and actual productive source](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/OUTER.md) · [Same-input backing and movement](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/STRIPED-BACKING.md)

A single lifted ternary chart acts on the product of cyclic address components. It retains every arbitrary record, high carry, predecessor reservation and independently returned owner. Balanced atom floors let both the full-atom transfer and the high-matrix transfer enter the previous stage. The two-width coprime-square controller also reduces the per-input dense Fourier setup from at least 2^(131072s³) entries in one previous root to at most 2^(2²⁰(s+1)²) steps and bits for the full new setup, with s = ceil(log₂(p+2)) on the stated tail. The striped consumer uses the actual 36-call binary and 48-call complex bodies. A retained rank-129 source forces a whole-window relocation. [Ordinary proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/MODULE-ATOMS.md) · [Binary receiver](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/growing_binary.py) · [Complex raw receiver and precision](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/COMPLEX.md) · [Signed product entry](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/product_path.py)

For a same-data control, the unstriped new receiver still used 618,597,324 bytes when the old high labels survived as arbitrary spectators. The 81-stripe physical check achieved the reduction in the table and increased summed tape travel 2.56-fold. The file product returned −345550037539 for −741503 times 466013, including the five nonzero pre-carry coefficients 11811, 10996, 4152, 868 and 77. The finite fixtures exercise smaller ranks and stopped kernels. The growing-rank conclusion uses the written proof. [Physical control](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/PRODUCT-CHECK.md) · [Signed file tests](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/check_binary_io.py)

With Python 3.12, the registered checks run from the repository root.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-stock-activation
```

The expected final line is `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/native-stock-activation outcome=completed`. All six commands also passed on the committed, read-only, Git-free export with zero external input files. The 68-file commit byte and mode check passed. These additional commands reproduce the C11 matcher measurements and formal replay.

```sh
p=research/native-stock-activation
python3.12 -I -B "$p/verify.py" physical stock
python3.12 -I -B "$p/verify_formal.py"
```

Hosted CI stopped before package selection. Its onboarding suite ran 760 tests with one failure and 24 skips. The navigation test expects `make frontier7000-verify`. The canonical base document still says `make frontier6030-verify`. I reproduced that exact assertion from four byte-identical base and head files. The six registered package checks passed locally and in the read-only export. [Hosted run](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44869791755) · [Base navigation test](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/tests/test_research_current_status.py) · [Base CI navigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57/docs/ci-verification.md)

Five Lean 4.34.1 modules passed independent kernel replay. Twenty axiom reports use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The new formal statements include the common chart action, all six stock inequalities, the physical exterior and source gap, the arbitrary-rank contact phase, stripe recombination and carry. Global approximation, compiler pricing and the bit-tape transcription remain written proofs. Author-side adversarial checks are complete. External scientific review remains open. [Verification and exact boundaries](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/VERIFICATION.md) · [Lean sources](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/tree/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/lean) · [Retained byte bindings](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/inputs/origins.json)

The base is canonical main at `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Ali Romman (@aliromman) prepared this work with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
